actions.title: Northshire
instructions: Stay together and complete the ordinary quests listed here. Every member follows the same route; no class quests or individual detours are included.
Pick up the flight paths on the route. From Stormwind, use Forever's direct ship to Auberdine when the guide sends the group to Darkshore.

actions.title: Turn in A Threat Within · Accept Kobold Camp Cleanup
Turn in Eagan Peltskinner · Accept Wolves Across The Border
Collect Tough Wolf Meat (x8)
instructions: Kill Young Wolves and Timber Wolves. Loot them for their Tough Wolf Meat
For these objectives, focus on Young Wolf.

actions.title: Turn in Wolves Across The Border
instructions: Turn in Wolves Across The Border

actions.title: Turn in Kobold Camp Cleanup · Accept Investigate Echo Ridge
Turn in Investigate Echo Ridge · Accept Skirmish at Echo Ridge
Collect Red Burlap Bandana (x12)
instructions: Kill Defias Thugs along this Northshire vineyard loop until every player has 12 Red Burlap Bandanas.

actions.title: Turn in Brotherhood of Thieves · Accept Milly Osworth · Accept Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
Kill Kobold Laborer (x12)
instructions: Kill Kobold Laborers inside Echo Ridge Mine

actions.title: Turn in Milly Osworth · Accept Milly's Harvest
Collect Milly's Harvest (x8)
instructions: Loot Milly's Harvest on the ground

actions.title: Collect Garrick's Head (x1)
instructions: Kill Garrick Padfoot. Loot him for his Head

actions.title: Turn in Milly's Harvest · Accept Grape Manifest
Turn in Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
instructions: Turn in Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

instructions: Turn in Skirmish at Echo Ridge

Elwynn Forest
instructions: Stay together and complete the ordinary quests listed here. Every member follows the same route; no class quests or individual detours are included.
Pick up the flight paths on the route. From Stormwind, use Forever's direct ship to Auberdine when the guide sends the group to Darkshore.

actions.title: Turn in The Adventurer · Accept The Great Outdoors
/sit emote in chat 1/1 · Gain boosted rest buff 1/1
instructions: Type "/sit" in chat and wait for one minute around the campfire

actions.title: Hand in The Great Outdoors. · Accept Camping 101: Cooking.
Turn in Report to Goldshire · Accept The Fargodeep Mine

phases.text: Turn in Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

actions.title: Chunk of Boar Meat (4)
instructions: Kill Stonetusk Boars. Loot them for their [Chunks of Boar Meat]

Supplies: 4 Chunk of Boar Meat per character. Use what you already have, buy the missing ingredients from the Auction House if affordable, or loot them on this route. Check this task only after you have the items; purchased supplies earn no kill XP. Extra gathering XP is not included in the estimate.

actions.title: Kobold Candle (8) · Gold Dust (10)
instructions: Kill Kobold Tunnelers in Fargodeep Mine until the listed candle and gold dust objectives are complete.

actions.title: Turn in Lost Necklace · Accept Pie for Billy
Turn in Pie for Billy · Accept Back to Billy
Accept Princess Must Die!
instructions: Talk to Ma Stonefield and accept Princess Must Die! before leaving the farm.

actions.title: Turn in Back to Billy · Accept Goldtooth
Scout Through the Fargodeep Mine
instructions: Enter one of the larger open spaces in Fargodeep Mine

actions.title: Bernice's Necklace (1)
instructions: Kill Goldtooth. Loot him for Bernice's Necklace
Be careful as he usually pulls with the Kobold Miner next to him

actions.title: Complete A Net Disaster
instructions: Loot the Fishing Nets in the water for the Half-Eaten Fish
These can be difficult to see

actions.title: Complete Slimy Menace · Complete Slimy Menace
Accept A Man About a Murloc
instructions: Talk to Jason Mathers in Elwynn Forest. Accept A Man About a Murloc.

actions.title: Turn in A Man About a Murloc
instructions: Talk to Remy "Two Times" in Elwynn Forest. Turn in A Man About a Murloc.

actions.title: Level 7 required: A Fishy Peril
instructions: Everyone taking this quest needs level 7 to accept it. If you are already high enough, continue to the pickup.
Finish the listed quest preparation before this pickup. No extra grinding is included.

actions.title: Accept A Fishy Peril
instructions: Do NOT vendor the [Bag of Marbles] reward. This is an incredibly valuable item all the way through to level 60

actions.title: Turn in The Fargodeep Mine · Turn in A Fishy Peril · Accept Further Concerns
Buy a [Small Brown Pouch] if needed
Shiny Junk (6)
instructions: Loot the Junk Piles on the ground for Shiny Junk
If you are unable to loot these due to too many Murlocs, skip this step

actions.title: Enter the Jasperlode Mine together
instructions: Scout Jasperlode on the way east. Stay together until every player receives exploration credit; report back on the planned Goldshire return.

actions.title: Scout through the Jasperlode Mine
instructions: Follow the path through middle to explore Jasperlode Mine

actions.title: Turn in Further Concerns · Accept Find the Lost Guards · Accept Protect the Frontier
Kill Prowler (x8) · Kill Young Forest Bear (x5)
instructions: Kill Prowlers and Young Forest Bears
Prioritize killing any Young Forest Bears you see

actions.title: Turn in Find the Lost Guards · Accept Discover Rolf's Fate
instructions: Turn in Find the Lost Guards
Click A half-eaten body on the ground

actions.title: Bundle of Wood (8)
instructions: Loot the Bundles of Wood on the ground at the base of the trees

actions.title: Turn in Discover Rolf's Fate · Accept Report to Thomas
instructions: Click Rolf's corpse on the ground
Be careful as Murloc Foragers will cast [Drink Minor Potion] which heals themselves for 61-68 health

actions.title: Turn in A Bundle of Trouble
instructions: Turn in A Bundle of Trouble

actions.title: Waterlogged Saw 1/1
instructions: Loot the Waterlogged Saw on the ground

actions.title: Waterlogged Axe 1/1
instructions: Loot the Waterlogged Axe on the ground

actions.title: Waterlogged Toolbox 1/1
instructions: Loot the Waterlogged Toolbox on the ground

actions.title: Collect Red Linen Bandana (x6)
instructions: Kill Defias Bandits. Loot them for their Red Linen Bandanas

actions.title: Collect Brass Collar (x1)
instructions: Kill Princess. Loot her for her Collar
Princess will aggro with both of her Porcine Entourage
Princess will also cast [Rushing Charge] which deals heavy damage
Be ready to use a [Lesser Healing Potion]

actions.title: Turn in Protect the Frontier · Turn in Report to Thomas
Turn in Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!
instructions: Turn in Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

actions.title: Huge Gnoll Claw (1)
instructions: Kill Hogger. Loot him for his Claw
Hogger can spawn in multiple locations
Kite him back to the guard tower if required ensuring you've done at least 50% damage to him

actions.title: Set your Hearthstone to Stormwind City
Collect Fang of Vagash (1)
instructions: Kill Vagash. Loot him for his Fang
Kite him to the guard south of the ranch. Make sure you do 51%+ damage to him
Watch the video below before you attempt to kill Vagash. It can be soloed on any class

actions.title: Accept The Public Servant · Accept Those Blasted Troggs!
instructions: Talk to Senator Mehr Stonehallow and Foreman Stonebrow

actions.title: Kill Rockjaw Skullthumper (x6) · Kill Rockjaw Bonesnapper (x10)
instructions: Kill Rockjaw Skullthumpers and Rockjaw Bonesnappers inside the cave

actions.title: Turn in Those Blasted Troggs! · Turn in The Public Servant
instructions: Talk to Foreman Stonebrow and Senator Mehr Stonehallow

actions.title: Dun Morogh: finish the Thanes lead-ins
instructions: After the eastern trogg hand-ins, return to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
Borrow his farsight, complete the Dark Iron Spy quest and collect a Dark Iron Map for every player. Start Underground Map at the spy camp before returning to Farsen.
Finish both hand-ins, then continue to Loch Modan. These quests will not need repeating before Hall of Thanes.

actions.title: Level 9 required: Farsen's Watch
instructions: Everyone taking this quest needs level 9 to accept it. If you are already high enough, continue to the pickup.
Finish the listed quest preparation before this pickup. No extra grinding is included.

actions.title: Use Farsen's Farsight
instructions: You can cancel the Farsight once the objective completes

actions.title: Turn in Farsen's Watch · Accept Nip 'Em in the Bud
Dark Iron Spy slain 10/10 · Accept Underground Map
instructions: Kill Dark Iron Spies. Loot them for the [Dark Iron Map]
Use the [Dark Iron Map] to start the quest

actions.title: Complete Underground Map
instructions: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.

actions.title: Turn in Nip 'Em in the Bud · Turn in Underground Map
instructions: Turn in Nip 'Em in the Bud

actions.title: Loch Modan
instructions: Stay together and complete the ordinary quests listed here. Every member follows the same route; no class quests or individual detours are included.
Pick up the flight paths on the route. From Stormwind, use Forever's direct ship to Auberdine when the guide sends the group to Darkshore.

actions.title: Accept Filthy Paws
instructions: Talk to Mountaineer Stormpike in Loch Modan. Accept Filthy Paws.

actions.title: Complete Filthy Paws
instructions: Loot Miners' League Crates until each player has 4 Miners' Gear.
Search the marked possible locations until everyone's quest objective is complete. If one location is empty, check the others.

actions.title: Turn in Filthy Paws
instructions: Talk to Mountaineer Stormpike in Loch Modan. Turn in Filthy Paws.
